title: Queueing Support for Automations
description: Devin introduced queueing support for automations, AI-generated review comments, and many smaller fixes and improvements.

community_feedback.quote: improvements in reliability and consistency, though noting Devin AI can sometimes get stuck in loops or make incorrect assumptions

title: Weekly Releases - CLI, VS Code Enhancements
description: GitHub Copilot released weekly updates including improvements for CLI resume and organization, VS Code review capabilities, side chats, shared sessions, and worktree workflows.

title: Google Workspace Plugins
description: Cursor can now read, write, and act across Google Workspace with new plugins for enhanced connectivity.

title: Self-Hosted Environments Public Beta
description: Claude Code added public beta self-hosted environments, allowing teams to run sessions on their own infrastructure with internal network access.

community_feedback.quote: I've been using Claude to work on a medium-sized (100+kLoc) codebase, and it's a great productivity multiplier.
Claude Code sessions were starting at ~35K tokens

title: 8 New Features Released
description: Claude Code released 8 new features including deeper agent integration and new safe mode.

title: GPT-5.5 Default Model and GPT-5.6 Integration
description: Codex CLI updated to use GPT-5.5 as the default model and began integrating GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra. Current version v0.144.0.

title: Final Preview Update Before Shutdown
description: Gemini CLI shipped a preview update with core reliability fixes, security improvements, enhanced context handling, and caretaker/triage improvements. The tool was officially shut down on June 18, 2026, replaced by Antigravity CLI.

title: Upcoming Model Deprecations
description: GitHub announced that several Copilot models will be deprecated starting September 1, 2026, affecting Copilot Chat, inline edits, Ask mode, and Agent modes.

community_feedback.quote: End of an Era... Copilot is DEAD
Users are complaining about significant price increases (Opus model reportedly ~2x the price)
Discussions about switching to cheaper models for lower-level tasks
Users noting that new Opus 4.7 model has 7.5x requests in Pro+ but costs 4x more
